title: Beatrix and the Orbit
author: Paloma Winterbourne
blurb: Jude Joubert, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
